# TC.ModemMessage

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.ModemMessage"></a>

### TC.ModemMessage

Accepted radar datagram delivered through a modem_message registration. Numeric
channels are distinct from wire colors. A dual-color receiver gets one event
per registration/receiver, with authorized wires ordered red before green. Data is isolated for
each delivery. Radio does not expose remote peripherals or sender authority.
No ACK, automatic reply, retry, retained mailbox or guaranteed reception exists.

Extends: TC.BaseEvent

### channel

Received numeric channel, 0..65535.

```text
integer
```

### distance (optional)

Euclidean distance in tiles on one surface; absent across surfaces.

```text
number
```

### message (optional)

Copied message; absent for explicit top-level nil.

```text
TC.Data
```

### name

Radio event discriminator.

```text
'modem_message'
```

### peripheral

Local receiving modem, not the sender.

```text
TC.PeripheralName
```

### replyChannel

Sender-specified numeric reply channel, 0..65535.

```text
integer
```

### sent_tick

Simulation tick of transmission acceptance.

```text
TC.Tick
```

### wire

First authorized receiver discovery color.

```text
TC.Wire
```

### wires

Receiver discovery colors in red-before-green order at acceptance.

```text
(TC.Wire)[]
```
